#### Graphing the MLE

Graph the log-likelihood with the MLE superimposed.

::::{.solution}

::: {#fig-cyclone-llik-mle}

```{r}
mle_data <- tibble::tibble(x = mle, y = loglik(mle))
ll_plot +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = mle_data, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y), col = "red")
```
